description: A drone generator built from sixteen oscillators: four harmonics, each with a pure sine and three waves made by multiplying two ramps together

params.text: Sets the pitch in whole octaves, three either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets the level of that oscillator, from silence to full

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, an octave per volt, added to the OCTAVE knob and held within four octaves either side of C4
Adds to that oscillator's level, a fifth per volt
This jack does not set the level of the oscillator beside it; the module reads the first jack of the top row for that one, though a voltage here does change the overall level

outputs.text: All sixteen oscillators added together and scaled so that the total comes out at about ±5V whatever the knobs are set to

notes: the four rows are the first, second, third and fourth harmonic; within a row the first column is a plain sine and the other three multiply that sine's ramp against a faster one.
the mix is divided by the sum of all sixteen levels, so turning one oscillator up quietens the rest rather than making the whole louder; with every knob at zero the output is silent.
the sixteen oscillators are free running and never reset, so their relationship drifts and the drone keeps moving without any modulation.
the level jack on the third row's first oscillator is wired to the wrong oscillator; every other jack matches the knob beside it.
